image_prompt: A middle-aged male music instructor rendered in cyberpunk anime style. He has sharp, angular facial features with a stern, intellectually weary expression conveying seven years of pedagogical frustration. His hair is dark and slicked back with a slight silver streak, styled with rigid precision. He wears a high-collared Victorian-influenced coat with neon-trimmed edges, fused with futuristic elements—intricate circuit patterns embroidered along the lapels in pale blue luminescence. His posture is rigidly formal, shoulders squared, embodying Prussian discipline. Beneath the coat, a fitted turtleneck with holographic threading. His eyes are intense, coal-dark with subtle cybernetic enhancement lines at the corners suggesting augmented perception. His hands are elegant but calloused from years of conducting and playing—visible fine motor control. A thin, resigned expression around his mouth suggests both intellectual superiority and quiet resignation. His overall silhouette combines austere formality with subtle technological integration, reflecting melancholic scholarly detachment.
book_context: Catherine the Great: A Life (or similar biographical work on Catherine II)
